value.rationale: The complete eleven-value multiplicity spectrum of a canonical Platonic vertex set is a natural finite invariant beyond the classical regular tetrahedron compounds. It gives the exact geometric-probability distribution for a uniformly chosen vertex quadruple, reveals 495 coplanar configurations, quantifies a strict 120-fold second-volume level and golden-ratio spectral gap, and reconciles a rational second moment with nonrational volume levels. Finite exhaustive classification is material here because all 4845 configurations are covered and the result supplies the whole previously unlocated table, not an arbitrary slice.
